title: Golden comments of one pull request
description: The findings of a pull request's first review, as the answer key an LLM judge compares a reviewer's findings with. The shape follows the golden-comment files of the Martian Code Review Bench (pr_title, comments[].comment, severity, category), with where each finding is and who raised it added.

commit.description: The first reviewed commit: the state every reviewer is given.

comments.description: Findings the owner's reply labels valid. A reviewer finding that states the same issue as one of these is a hit.

not_accepted.description: Findings raised in the first review that the owner's reply does not label valid. Not part of the key.

comment.description: The issue as the bot stated it: its title, then its explanation, as plain text. This is what the judge reads.

category.description: The bot's own label for the kind of issue; null when it gave none.
